SELECT p.key, p.source_id, p.record_class, p.scope, p.current_version_id, p.last_known_good_version_id,
    p.promoted_at, (p.validation_receipt - 'excludedFacts') || jsonb_build_object('excludedFacts','[]'::jsonb) validation_receipt,
    (WITH selected AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT coalesce(array_agg(logical),'{}'::text[]) AS exact_keys,
    coalesce(array_agg(logical) FILTER (WHERE logical ~ '^(zip|cell):'),'{}'::text[]) AS location_keys,
    ('$[*] ? (@.id == $exact[*]' || coalesce(string_agg(' || @.id starts with ' || to_jsonb(logical||':state:')::text,'')
      FILTER (WHERE logical ~ '^(zip|cell):'),'') || ')')::jsonpath AS native_path
  FROM (SELECT substring(key FROM 21) AS logical
    FROM unnest($3::text[]) requested(key) WHERE starts_with(key,'open-data-partition:')) keys
), decoded AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT reader_payload_node(p.payload) AS header
  WHERE p.record_class='CURATED_READER_RECORD' AND p.source_id IN ('epa-echo','socrata-discovery')
    AND p.scope=p.source_id||':national'
), partition_node AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT reader_payload_node(header->'partitions') AS node FROM decoded
), array_metadata AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT node, CASE WHEN node->>'kind'='array'
    THEN coalesce((reader_payload_value(node->'order')#>>'{}')::jsonb,'null'::jsonb)
    ELSE '[]'::jsonb END AS positions FROM partition_node
), chosen_groups AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT (group_index-1)::integer AS group_id, members.ordinal_index AS member_index,
    reader_payload_value(members.item) AS value
  FROM array_metadata CROSS JOIN selected
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(CASE WHEN node->>'kind'='array'
    THEN coalesce(node->'groups','null'::jsonb) ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) WITH ORDINALITY groups(group_node,group_index)
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL reader_payload_members(group_node) members
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT reader_payload_node(item)->>'id' AS native_id OFFSET 0) native
  WHERE native.native_id=ANY(selected.exact_keys)
    OR split_part(native.native_id,':state:',1)=ANY(selected.location_keys)
), chosen_order AS (
  SELECT global_index, (group_id#>>'{}')::integer AS group_id,
    row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY group_id ORDER BY global_index) AS member_index
  FROM array_metadata
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(positions) WITH ORDINALITY original(group_id,global_index)
  WHERE (group_id#>>'{}')::integer IN (SELECT group_id FROM chosen_groups)
), chosen AS (
  SELECT global_index AS ordinal_index,chosen_groups.value FROM chosen_groups JOIN chosen_order USING(group_id,member_index)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT members.ordinal_index,reader_payload_value(item) AS value
  FROM partition_node CROSS JOIN selected
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_path_query(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(node)='array' THEN node ELSE '[]'::jsonb END,
    selected.native_path,jsonb_build_object('exact',to_jsonb(selected.exact_keys))) WITH ORDINALITY members(item,ordinal_index)
) SELECT CASE
  WHEN p.record_class='CURATED_READER_RECORD' AND p.source_id IN ('epa-echo','socrata-discovery')
    AND p.scope=p.source_id||':national' AND header->>'kind'='open-data' AND header->>'sourceId'=p.source_id
  THEN CASE WHEN header ? 'partitions' THEN reader_payload_value(header-'partitions') || jsonb_build_object('partitions',
    coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(value ORDER BY ordinal_index) FROM chosen),'[]'::jsonb))
    ELSE reader_place_payload(p.payload,$3::text[],NULL) END
  ELSE NULL END FROM decoded) payload,
    c.retrieved_at, reader_payload_node(c.candidate)->'temporal' temporal FROM civic_data_promotions p
    JOIN civic_data_candidates c ON c.id=p.current_version_id
    WHERE p.record_class=$1 AND p.scope=$2 AND c.state='PROMOTED' AND $3::text[] IS NOT NULL
